comments.author: Chester
comments.body: I think some people need to read up on what piracy actually is, yes granted its easier for pirates to hit traders at ports than out at sea all pirates camp ports, and as there ships wont allow them to go far or faster than a trader can out at sea, yet the safest place for a trader is at a port, wait till they dock or sail the wrong way, watch him for 5mins you'll learn how to avoid him check his ships stats/cargo you'll get an idea of when he needs to dock to get provisions etc see how you can turn that to your advantage instead of just rushing out hoping he or any other pirate wont attack, and why should he fight a BH or another pirate if he knows he cant win, doesn't make him a fake just makes em sensible the last thing any pirate wants is to lose there bounty and have to stop pirating for an hour
